land_pattern.notes: From the D (R-PDSO-G14) LAND PATTERN DATA sheet (drawing 4211283-3/E, 08/12), Example Board Layout: 12 x 1.27 mm pitch (7 pads per row), 5.40 mm between the centerlines of the two pad rows. Pad geometry 0.60 mm x 1.55 mm, non-soldermask-defined with solder mask opening 0.07 mm larger all around. Stencil openings 14 x 0.55 mm x 1.50 mm. Identical to the SN74LVC00AD land pattern (same TI drawing).
